description: This is a test class for the StartedKamonTimer class, verifying timer behaviors, segment handling, tagging, and stop callbacks in a metrics instrumentation context.

classes.name: StartedKamonTimerTest
classes.description: Test suite for the StartedTimer implementation, covering lifecycle, segment management, tagging, and callback invocation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a new timer instance before each test.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Verifies that the timer's name is correctly returned.

methods.name: getOnStopHandlers
methods.description: Tests addition of onStop handlers and retrieval of the handler list.

methods.name: onStopIsCalled
methods.description: Ensures that registered onStop handlers are invoked upon stopping the timer.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks whether the timer correctly reports its running state.

methods.name: stopAStoppedTimerCausesException
methods.description: Verifies that stopping an already stopped timer throws an exception.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Tests segment creation and retrieval within the timer.

methods.name: segmentHasSameTags
methods.description: Checks that segments inherit the parent's tags and include their own segment-specific tag.

methods.name: segmentsAreGettingStoppedToo
methods.description: Verifies that stopping the parent timer stops associated segments.

methods.name: onStopHandlersOfSegmentsAreCalledToo
methods.description: Ensures onStop handlers registered on segments are invoked when segments are stopped.

methods.name: startTimeStampAlwaysSet
methods.description: Checks that the timer's start timestamp is initialized and greater than zero.

methods.name: canHandleAlreadyStoppedSegments
methods.description: Verifies proper handling of stopping segments that are already stopped.

methods.name: taggingWorks
methods.description: Tests that tagging with different value types results in correct string representations.
